messages:
support-liz: Hey folks, multiple customers escalating 5xx + timeouts on the hosted inference API since ~10:04 UTC. Getting surge of 502/504s and some timeouts. seeing billing noise as retries spike. sample error from customer A: 502 gateway error. Can we triage?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 (severity: high) — auto-alert from gateway 5xx spike, 10:06:22 UTC

sre-meera: Thanks Liz — looking at alerts now. Which route/model/region? any pattern in customer IDs or regions?

support-liz: All over: eu-west1 and us-central. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. A couple customers hit high token billing due to client retries.

eng-jamal: FYI we pushed a staged deploy at 10:00 that enabled the new proxy header sanitizer (flag: gateway.header_sanitize=true) as a 10% canary to edge-pool-3. It touched the gateway proxy that rewrites auth headers before routing.

sre-ryan: Jamal — can you paste the exact flag value and rollout target? any recent changes to header size handling?

eng-jamal: rollout: traffic tag "staged-2026-03-08" -> 10% on edge-pool-3. config snippet: ```json
{
  "gateway": { "header_sanitize": true, "sanitize_mode": "strict", "max_header_bytes": 8192 }
}
```

sre-meera: Seeing traces that show upstreams returning "connection reset" and a few "502 downstream termination" logs from the gateway process. Correlating with canary instances spin-up times.

sre-ryan: Repro attempt: curl against canary host returns 502 quickly. curl example: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.staged-2026.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
``` Response: ```HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: redwood-gw/1.2.3
X-Request-Id: rq_abcdef

{"error":"upstream returned 502"}```

eng-mike: Logs from the canary show the header sanitizer trimming the Authorization header in some cases when sanitize_mode=strict -> upstream rejects auth -> 401/then client retries -> proxy returns 502 because upstream closes connection. There's also a path where header rewrite causes chunking mismatch and upstream errors out.

sre-meera: That would explain both 5xx and retry/billing amplification. Any idea why only some requests are hit? Possibly atypical auth header formats (long x-client metadata) that hit the new sanitize rule.

eng-jamal: We rolled strict because of old abuse patterns, but we didn't scope to header keys; strict mode is too aggressive. I recommend flipping the canary flag back to false and re-routing canary traffic to stable immediately.

sre-ryan: Agreed. Proposed mitigation steps: 1) pause canary traffic allocation 2) set gateway.header_sanitize=false for staged-2026 tag 3) reroute traffic off edge-pool-3 to stable 4) communicate to CS with templated status. I'll run them now.

sre-meera: I'll monitor 5xx rate and token billing after rollback.

eng-jamal: Running rollback: ```bash
# undo flag via config service
configctl set staged-2026 gateway.header_sanitize false --tag staged-2026
# reassign canary traffic
trafficctl set-target staged-2026 edge-pool-3=0 edge-pool-stable=100
```

eng-mike: Also to be safe, we should add a quick canary test that hits auth header variants before re-enabling strict. I'll draft tests.

sre-ryan: Done applying rollback, starting routing change. Patch applied at 10:18 UTC.

oncall-bot: Rollout action completed: staged-2026 config update at 10:18:57 UTC.

sre-meera: Metrics: 5xx rate dropped ~85% in the last 5 minutes on affected routes. Timeouts decreasing.

support-liz: Thanks — I'm sending customer-facing update: "We identified a canary config change to header sanitization that caused upstream auth failures for some requests. We reverted the canary and are monitoring. Please retry; if you still see errors include X-Request-Id and we'll trace." 

eng-jamal: Added temporary mitigations: log full header lengths and sample problematic headers (no tokens logged) to help write a narrower sanitize rule.

eng-mike: I'll open a follow-up ticket to implement whitelisting for auth headers and add unit tests.

sre-ryan: Postmortem owners? Jamal + Meera. Incident page: link to INC-2026-045 will include timeline and rollback commands.

support-liz: I'll coordinate customer comms and billing credits where needed.

sre-meera: Closing loop: last check at 10:43 UTC shows stable error rate near baseline. Keeping watch for 30m. :thumbsup:

eng-jamal: Thanks all — major lesson: don't enable strict header sanitization in canary without header-format tests.

support-liz: 👍 will follow up with customers and add repro snippets.

sre-ryan: Marking incident as mitigated, monitoring for recurrence.
